snippet.title: Valor Mortis - Release Date Trailer | Demo Available Today
snippet.description:
The Valor Mortis Demo is available today on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2828710/Valor_Mortis/

We are also extremely excited to announce that legendary French actor, Vincent Cassel, will be starring as the voice of Napoleon in Valor Mortis. 

This is our first time going completely open and public with access to the game. We believe we have created a unique soulslike game, with a dash of FPS and even platforming action from our past Ghostrunner titles. At the core, Valor Mortis is a challenging experience, so this Demo is also our way of fine tuning that difficulty. 

Wishlist Now!
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2828710/Valor_Mortis/
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10016571
Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/store/valor-mortis/9p861v1542bl

Coming to Steam, PS5, and Xbox, and day one with Xbox Game Pass.

Discord https://discord.com/invite/valormortis
Twitter https://x.com/ValorMortis
Bluesky https://bsky.app/profile/valormortis.bsky.social
